use default

struct RATIONAL(numerator: bigint, denominator: bigint) is
    +(other: RATIONAL) -> RATIONAL => reduced(
        numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator,
        denominator * other.denominator)

    -(other: RATIONAL) -> RATIONAL => reduced(
        numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator,
        denominator * other.denominator)

    *(other: RATIONAL) -> RATIONAL => reduced(
        numerator * other.numerator, denominator * other.denominator)

    /(other: RATIONAL) -> RATIONAL => reduced(
        numerator * other.denominator, denominator * other.numerator)

    to_string() -> string =>
        if denominator =~ 1n then "{numerator}"
        else "{numerator}/{denominator}" fi
si

reduced(numerator: bigint, denominator: bigint) -> RATIONAL is
    let divisor = bigint.greatest_common_divisor(numerator, denominator)
    let sign = if denominator < 0n then -1 else 1 fi
    let scale = divisor * cast(sign)

    return RATIONAL(numerator / scale, denominator / scale)
si

whole(value: int) -> RATIONAL =>
    RATIONAL(cast(value), 1n)

class SERIES(term: (int) -> RATIONAL) is
    _known: LIST[RATIONAL]

    init(..) is
        _known = LIST()
    si

    at(index: int) -> RATIONAL is
        while _known.count <= index do
            _known.add(term(_known.count))
        od

        return _known[index]
    si

    +(other: SERIES) -> SERIES => SERIES(n => at(n) + other.at(n))

    -(other: SERIES) -> SERIES => SERIES(n => at(n) - other.at(n))

    *(other: SERIES) -> SERIES => SERIES(n =>
        (0::n)
            |> map(k => at(k) * other.at(n - k))
            |> reduce(whole(0), (sum, term) => sum + term))

    /(other: SERIES) -> SERIES is
        let quotient mut = SERIES(_ => whole(0))

        quotient = SERIES(n => (
            let carried = (1::n)
                |> map(k => other.at(k) * quotient.at(n - k))
                |> reduce(whole(0), (sum, term) => sum + term)

            (at(n) - carried) / other.at(0)))

        return quotient
    si

    differentiate() -> SERIES => SERIES(n => at(n + 1) * whole(n + 1))

    integrate() -> SERIES =>
        SERIES(n => if n == 0 then whole(0) else at(n - 1) / whole(n) fi)

    show(name: string, count: int) is
        let terms = (0..count) |> map(n => at(n).to_string()) |> join(", ")

        write_line("{name}: {terms}")
    si
si

constant(value: int) -> SERIES =>
    SERIES(n => if n == 0 then whole(value) else whole(0) fi)

let sine mut = constant(0)
let cosine mut = constant(0)

sine = SERIES(n => cosine.integrate().at(n))
cosine = SERIES(n => (constant(1) - sine.integrate()).at(n))

sine.show("sin", 11)
cosine.show("cos", 11)
(sine / cosine).show("tan", 11)
(sine * sine + cosine * cosine).show("sin^2 + cos^2", 11)
sine.differentiate().show("d/dx sin", 11)
